## What to build

Criteria-based bulk relocation, reconciliation and conditional undo. Owner: ecochran76, delegated implementation owner recorded in repository ledger. Delivery target: validated integration branch, no merge/deployment.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Preview freezes selected tabs, source/destination identity and native process births; apply moves only exact same-server tmux tabs without restarting processes or switching focus.
- [ ] Support last-tab transfer while retaining empty saved source definition; reject incompatible/linked or stale namespaces before mutation.
- [ ] Durably record each in-flight effect, report partial/held/uncertain results and reconcile lost replies/restarts without blind replay.
- [ ] Undo only unchanged resulting placement; preserve subsequent manual moves and create routing holds.
- [ ] Expose session drain using the same frozen selection and per-tab outcomes.
